extracted.intended_audience: federally recognized tribes, tribal leaders/governments, and stakeholders interested in Interior Department tribal consultation policy
extracted.subtask_description: Announcing the Department of the Interior's effort to create a Department-wide tribal consultation policy to implement Executive Order 13175 and a Presidential memorandum; solicits tribal input and lists a schedule of consultation meetings. The page communicates procedural deadlines and mechanisms for tribes to participate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Respect for inherent sovereignty / nation-to-nation relationship
rubrics_metrics.description: The Department must respect the inherent sovereignty of Indian nations and honor commitments to American Indian and Alaska Native communities; the federal government must uphold a government-to-government relationship and a nation-to-nation relationship.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quoted rationale from Secretary Salazar: 'President Obama respects the inherent sovereignty of Indian nations and believes that the federal government must honor its commitments to American Indian and Alaska Native communities.' The consultation policy should reflect and operationalize that respect in how the Department engages tribes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consistency and comprehensiveness of Department-wide consultation policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop 'a consistent and comprehensive Department-wide tribal consultation policy and process upon which tribes can rely.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Policy should be uniform across the Department (not fragmented by bureau) and comprehensive in scope so tribes can depend on predictable processes and standards for consultation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conformity with Presidential memorandum and Executive Order 13175
rubrics_metrics.description: The new policy effort must be consistent with the requirements of the November 5 Presidential memorandum directing agencies to implement the policies and directives of Executive Order 13175 – Consultation and Coordination With Indian Tribal Governments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Department's plan and policy content should implement the policies/directives set forth in EO13175 and the November 5 memorandum; see referenced documents for the substantive obligations to be incorporated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Develop and submit a 'plan of actions' to OMB within 90 days
rubrics_metrics.description: Each agency head is directed to submit to the Director of the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) within 90 days a detailed plan of actions the agency will take to implement EO13175 policies and directives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Department must prepare a detailed, timebound plan describing actions to implement consultation policies and deliver it to OMB within the 90-day deadline set by the Presidential memorandum.

rubrics_metrics.name: Solicit tribal comments via multiple channels by specified deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: The Department is seeking tribal comments via email, regular mail and in real-time meetings by January 15, 2010, on questions asking what the parameters of a comprehensive Interior Department-wide consultation policy should entail.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Public input must be accepted through written (email, postal) and in-person/real-time meeting formats; tribes should respond on the parameters/content of the policy by the stated deadline to inform the Department's plan.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hold consultation meetings at announced locations and times
rubrics_metrics.description: A preliminary schedule of Departmental tribal consultation meetings is provided (dates, local times, and locations), covering December 2009 and January 2010 events in specified cities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Meetings are scheduled for: Dec 2 (Anchorage, AK), Dec 9 (Portland, OR), Dec 14 (Washington, D.C.), Jan 5 (Minneapolis, MN), Jan 7 (Oklahoma City, OK), Jan 12 (Phoenix, AZ), Jan 14 (Sacramento, CA). Times listed: 9:00 a.m.–12:00 noon and 1:00 p.m.–4:00 p.m. (local time). Tribes are expected to attend these sessions or use other submission channels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusive outreach to all federally recognized tribes
rubrics_metrics.description: The policy-development effort will be developed 'with input from the nation’s 564 federally recognized tribes.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Outreach and consultation processes should be designed to engage each federally recognized tribe and provide opportunities for meaningful input across the full set of tribes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Solicit input on the 'parameters' of a comprehensive policy
rubrics_metrics.description: The Department requests tribal comments specifically 'on questions asking what the parameters of a comprehensive Interior Department-wide consultation policy should entail.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tribal responses should address the scope, standards, processes, and procedural safeguards that would make the Department's consultation policy comprehensive and reliable; the page does not enumerate those parameters but explicitly asks tribes to propose them.
